description: This file contains utility functions and editor enhancements for managing list structures (ordered and unordered lists) within a rich text editor built with Slate.js. It includes functions for toggling list types, nesting, unnesting, and normalizing list nodes.

methods.name: isListType
methods.description: Checks if a given node type is an 'ordered-list' or 'unordered-list'.

methods.name: isListNode
methods.description: Type guard to determine if a node is a list node of type 'ordered-list' or 'unordered-list'.

methods.name: toggleList
methods.description: Toggles the list type (ordered or unordered) for the current selection in the editor.

methods.name: getAncestorList
methods.description: Finds the nearest ancestor list and list item nodes above the current selection.

methods.name: withList
methods.description: Enhances the editor with list management capabilities, including custom insertBreak, normalizeNode, and deleteBackward behaviors.

methods.name: nestList
methods.description: Nests a list item into a nested list if possible.

methods.name: unnestList
methods.description: Unnests a list item from its parent list.
